6297.title: Message commands lose content during timeline deferral
6297.rootCauseOneLine: Timeline deferral truncates commands after grouping recognizes a successful send, so the client receives incomplete message syntax or content.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed, unmerged; preserves full recognized commands. Branch not executed.
Closed, unmerged; no change to the deferred-content producer. Branch not executed.

6297.proposedFix: Keep recognized successful sends inline at the server deferral boundary, reusing the existing parser and retaining ordinary command deferral.
6297.caveats: Second clean API reproduction by the same agent. Browser verification blocked by missing Chrome/Chromium; no screenshot. Quoted commands can parse partially rather than become generic rows.
